questions.q: How did the stepmother treat the stepdaughter?
o: She beat and scolded her and starved her
questions.e: She beat and scolded her and made her suffer hunger and cold.

questions.q: Where did the girl go after the stepmother drove her out?
o: Into the forest, where she saw a distant fire
questions.e: She wandered into the forest and spotted a fire far away.

questions.q: What did the girl do in the hut?
o: Swept it, tidied the fire and added wood
questions.e: She swept the hut and built up the fire.

questions.q: What did the ala ask about her head, and what did the girl answer?
o: Does it smell? — “No, mother, it smells like immortelle flowers”
questions.e: “Smrdi li moja glava?” — “Ne smrdi, majko! već miriše kao smilj.”

questions.q: Which chest did the kind girl choose, and why?
o: The lightest one, because she thought she hadn't earned more
questions.e: She took the lightest chest: for those few days she hadn't earned more.

questions.q: What was inside the kind girl's chest?
How did the story end for the stepmother and her daughter?
o: Snakes leapt from the heavy chest and drank out their eyes
They made peace with the stepdaughter
questions.e: Two snakes leapt out of the chest and drank their eyes out.
